meta.title: Session Share
meta.description: Export any conversation as Markdown, a self-contained HTML page, or JSON — from the reply you are reading, with tool calls folded and secrets redacted.

action.title: Export / share this conversation
dialog.title: Export conversation
dialog.subtitle: Pick a format, how far back to include, and what to leave out. Nothing is sent anywhere: the file is written on this machine.
format.markdownHint: .md — plain text, diffs cleanly, pastes into any editor or wiki
format.htmlHint: .html — one self-contained file, opens offline in any browser
format.jsonHint: .json — structured transcript for scripts and backups
redact.label: Redact secrets
redact.hint: API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys are replaced with a placeholder.
save.hint: Writes the file into {dir} so it is listed in the export library.
summary.empty: This conversation has no exportable messages yet.
error.copy: Could not copy to the clipboard; the file was still produced.
error.route: The exporter is not reachable. Reload the page; if that does not help, the plugin's Host half is not running.
library.title: Export library
library.subtitle: Every export this plugin saved on this machine.
library.column.name: File
library.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? This removes the file from disk.
html.title: Conversation export
